_doc: SINGLE SOURCE of the per-surface syntax & policy DELTAS across the four FlatBars dialects (RawBars, FullBars, MaxBars, MinBars). Authored here; everything downstream is DERIVED and drift-gated by `check:surface-syntax` (run `npm run gen:surface-syntax` after editing). Consumers: the Lab projection lab/surface-syntax.mjs (the surface-aware Reference popup), the generated spec partial spec/src/partials/surface-deltas.mdx, and the tutorials' <SurfaceDeltas> component. The prelude OPERATION list is NOT here — that is operations.json (the ops are shared across surfaces); this file is only the surface sugar + value-policy deltas. Truthiness rules: ADR-022. Set-delimiters: ADR-015 (MinBars only). MaxBars variable model: ADR-021.

rowKinds.shared: available in this surface (may also exist in others)
rowKinds.only: distinctive to this surface within the ladder

surfaces.label: RawBars
surfaces.tagline: The desugared core surface — core skeleton syntax, no sugar.

truthiness.note: 0 is truthy; empty containers are falsy

rows.note: Triple-stash only; no {{ }} auto-escape shorthand.
Explicit lookup helper; no dotted-path sugar.
Manual — escaping is a helper, never implicit.
Parens group a nested application into one argument.
Core block; head is a helper application.
Inverse via the unless helper — no {{^}} sigil.
Bare scoped ops: index, key, first, last, length. No @-data.
Dropped by the lexer.
Called as the partial helper, unescaped. The context is optional (defaults to the current one); pass one to override, plus an optional hash.
The caller's body inside a block partial — the hyphen-free yield (FullBars uses partial-block; ADR-005).

surfaces.label: FullBars
surfaces.tagline: The Handlebars-faithful surface — auto-escape, dotted paths, @-data.

truthiness.note: {} is truthy; 0 is falsy unless includeZero=true

rows.note: {{ }} auto-escapes; {{{ }}} or {{&value}} for raw.
Dotted paths, parent climb ../x, and @root.
Rename the loop bindings.
Parens group nested applications.
Scoped data installed by each / with.
Surface sugar; desugars to the partial helper.
The caller's body inside {{#> }}/{{#partial}} — Handlebars' partial-block (RawBars/MaxBars use yield; ADR-005).
{{else}} separator; {{^x}} inverted section.
Handles }} within the comment body.

surfaces.label: MaxBars
surfaces.tagline: The flagship — FullBars plus infix operators and pipes.

truthiness.note: 0 is truthy; same rule as RawBars

rows.note: Desugar to helpers: multiply, gte, and, or, not, coalesce.
Left value becomes the helper's first argument.
&& || ! ?? as infix, ?: (Elvis truthy-coalesce), and the ternary cond ? a : b; group with parens.
Reserved names instead of @root / ../  (no @-sigil).
Bare scoped ops or labelled loop / outer chains (ADR-021).
The as |…| bars are distinct from the pipe operator.
Inherits the FullBars escape model.
Bare yield (no @partial-block); rejects {{^}} and {{#*inline}}.

truthiness.note: 0, "", {} are all truthy (the language-agnostic spec rule)

rows.note: {{ }} escapes; {{{ }}} and {{&}} are raw.
Shape decides: list iterates, truthy shows once.
Renders when the value is falsy / empty.
The current scalar inside an array section.
Switch the active pair mid-template — MinBars only (ADR-015).
Standalone; no context override in base Mustache.
Parent / block-override template inheritance.
Dropped by the lexer.
